{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values (divide by 10)
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 3: Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check final shape
print(f'Final number of patients: {len(df_clean)}')

# Check arm distribution by severity after cleaning
print('\nFinal arm distribution by severity:')
print(df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
